adjudication.rationale: In apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts the handler does `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` with no try/catch or validation around either operation. If `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is wrong/missing (it even falls back to an empty string) or if `reqBody.keys` decrypts to non-JSON, `symmetricDecrypt` and/or `JSON.parse` can throw, which will bubble out of the API route and result in an unhandled 500 response.
